etymology_text:
Inherited from Proto-Sabaki *-fyoma, from Common Bantu *-píoma. This word was inherited through the Northern dialects. Doublet of -fyoma (“to recite the Qurʾān”), which is the result of regular inheritence in the Southern dialects.
Cognate with Giryama -shoma and Mwani -fyoma.

etymology_text: The use as a focus marker is original. This then acquired a presentative meaning (“it is”), which was finally reanalyzed as a copula. Cognate with Chichewa ndi.

examples.text: Lengo la Mwalimu Nyerere kujiuzulu nafasi hiyo lilikuwa ni pamoja na kukiimarisha chama cha TANU kuweza kuyakabili vizuri majukumu ya uhuru.

examples.english: Mwalimu Nyerere's goal when he resigned from that position was nothing but to strengthen the TANU party to be able to effectively face the responsibilities of independence.
